A companion app for the F4HWN firmware: UV Studio with the USB cable, plus CHIRP images, CHIRP drivers and firmware assets on the phone. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0, like the firmware project. Not affiliated with Quansheng.
By Armel FAUVEAU (F4HWN), with K5Viewer and UVTools2 by the same author. Apache License 2.0. The app does not include UV Studio: it opens the live site and gives it the USB serial link it needs.

Edition Fusion for the UV-K1 and UV-K5 V3, by Armel FAUVEAU (F4HWN), muzkr and contributors, based on the Dual Tachyon and Egzumer firmwares. Apache License 2.0. The programming protocol and the firmware asset format used here are the firmware\'s.

The .img format and the channel and setting layout follow CHIRP (Dan Smith and contributors) and the F4HWN driver (F4HWN, JOC2, Egzumer, from the UV-K5 driver by SQ5BPF), licensed under the GNU GPL. Neither is included: driver files are downloaded or loaded when you ask, and only read.
usb-serial-for-android (Google Inc., Mike Wakerly; MIT License), AndroidX WebKit and Core (The Android Open Source Project) and the Kotlin standard library (JetBrains), both Apache License 2.0.
